statement: Every essential arrangement of 7 straight lines satisfies 3F + 2Q + (2/3) sum_p (k_p-2)^2 <= 35, where F is the number of bounded triangular faces, Q counts parallel pairs, and p ranges over finite multipoints.

scope.essentiality_clause: at least one pair of lines crosses
scope.order_table_relaxation: all parallel and finite concurrency patterns free

soundness: The order-table CNF is a necessary relaxation containing every essential straight-line arrangement. Selected triples imply triangular faces by the direct-gap theorem; no positive selection target is imposed. A geometric violation selects all of its faces and satisfies the scaled score threshold, so verified UNSAT proves the stated straight-line inequality at n=7.
